about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you are into live music, you might like [[Music]] or [[Rock]], which are great ways to meet people with similar taste. You can also check out [[Gigs]] to see what is coming up at the Students' Union.

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply:
You might like [[Film]] for movie nights, [[Book]] for reading together, and [[Gaming and Roleplay]] for board games. 

Have a look at the Societies page to find out more about them.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply:
For your run, you might enjoy [[Walking]] or [[Cycling]]. 

If you want to play sport with a team, take a look at [[Football]] on the Sport page.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: For films and the big screen, you might enjoy [[Film]] to chat about all things cinema. Have a look at the Societies page to browse more ideas too.

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply:
Since you're into gaming, you might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]] to meet other gamers on campus. 

You can also check out [[Esports]] for competitive gaming or [[Video Game]] for general chat and events.

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: For big nights out and clubbing, you might enjoy [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] to see what is coming up. If you are looking for societies where you can meet people who share those interests, you can also browse the full list on the [[Societies]] page.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply:
For hiking and long walks, you might like [[Walking]], and for climbing you could try [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]]. 

Have a look on the Societies page to find out more about them.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply:
If you enjoy craft and nature, you might like to take a look at [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] or [[Walking]]. 

You can also browse the full list of groups on the Societies page to see what else catches your eye.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Since you like quiet and non-sporty things, what sorts of hobbies or creative interests do you enjoy? That will help me suggest a society that fits you well.

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: For reading and quiet nights in, you might like [[Book]] for reading discussions and [[Film]] for movie chats. You can also check out the Societies page to browse more options.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply:
If you love indie bands and live music, you might enjoy checking out [[Music]]. 

You can also have a look at the [[Gigs]] page to see what is coming up at the Students' Union.

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply:
Everyone is welcome to join the [[Ukrainian]] society to learn about the culture and meet people. 

Have you had a look at your [[Checklist]] in the app yet?

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: It is completely normal to feel that way, but you will find plenty of people in the same boat. Have a look at [[Mature Students]] to meet others in a similar position.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: It is completely understandable to feel worried about money, but please do not panic because there is support available. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] for help with money worries in one place, or visit [[Food Pantry]] if you need some help with groceries.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear that things are tough this week, but there is help available right on campus. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] to find out about free food support and other ways NSU can help with money worries.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply:
Try not to panic, as you can get support with this through the [[Advice Centre]], which guides you on academic misconduct. 

Have you had a chance to look at your checklist or take a look around the app yet?

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply:
That sounds really frustrating to deal with, but you can certainly get help with that issue. 

You can check out the [[Advice Centre]] for guides and support on housing problems and how to handle disputes with landlords.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply: You can check out [[Swimming]] for training and team sessions. Have a look at its card for prices and times.

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: You can take a look at [[Football]] to see Northumbria Sport's teams and how to get involved.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: That is brilliant, we have [[Ice Hockey]] which should be right up your street! Have a look on the Societies page to see more about it.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply: It is great that you want to get fitter this year. Since you have not done much sport before, you might enjoy trying [[Pilates]] or [[Yoga]] for a gentle start.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: That sounds like a lovely hobby, and [[Hooked By Crochet]] would be a great fit for you.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: You can find all their details and contact options by checking [[Hooked By Crochet]].

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply:
If you like climbing, you might enjoy [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]]. 

You can also check out [[Sport]] to browse all the Northumbria Sport clubs if you want to keep active.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: Just write the name of the society in double square brackets, like [[Climbing]], and the app will show you its details, contact buttons and how to join.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: Yes, we have [[Gaming and Roleplay]] which is great for board games and tabletop role-playing. Have a look on that page to see what they are up to.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: For details on what [[Gaming and Roleplay]] is like, you can check their page on the app. Have you had a chance to look at your [[Checklist]] yet?

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply: If you love films, you might like [[Film]] or [[Film & TV Production]]. You can also browse all the options on the Societies page.
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: You can check the [[Film]] page for contact details and links. Have you had a look at your Checklist yet?
